headline: 198 RENA PRODUCED A WRITTEN OFFER — the first paper any listing on this board has ever generated off a showing — and you had the breakdown, both net sheets and a recommended counter to the sellers by 5:38 this morning; then three appointments land in a 45-minute window today: Fieldstone 11:00, the Lake Crest septic 11:00, and Ridge Trail 11:45.
